$comment: Single source of truth. Tailwind reads this for web; React Native reads it for mobile. Never hardcode a value that lives here. Derived from design-reference/maison2.html and product.html.
$direction: maison — noir base, brass accent, bone text

$contrastNotes.rule: Never introduce a grey lighter than #8B837A on noir. Anything below 4.5:1 fails.

font.$usage: Amiri for Arabic headings only. Bodoni Moda for Latin small-caps labels only (always letterspaced). IBM Plex Sans Arabic for everything else.

fontSize.$desktopNote: The ramp above is the PHONE ramp. From 1024px the Lg steps take over: a 33px headline on a 27-inch monitor reads as a phone screenshot, not as a maison.
fontSize.$minimumNote: HIG mobile minimum is 11pt. The 9.5 and 10.5 values are permitted ONLY for letterspaced Bodoni labels and numeric captions, never for reading text.

lineHeight.$comment: Arabic needs more leading than Latin. Set for Arabic first.

motion.$comment: Luxury motion has weight. Things settle; they never pop, bounce or spring.
motion.$rule: Nothing under 120ms — below that a transition reads as a glitch, not a move.

easing.$forbidden: No spring. No overshoot. No ease-in-back. A bouncing element reads as a consumer app instantly.

haptic.$comment: Mobile only. Subtle, meaningful, rare. Haptics on every tap is noise.

elevation.$rule: There is deliberately no shadow scale. Depth comes from value (l1 → l2 → l3) and hairlines. A drop shadow requires written justification.

size.$rule: 44pt is the hard minimum for anything tappable. A control may LOOK smaller (e.g. a 36px circle) but its hit area must be 44pt.
